title: Senior Content Writer
description: Company Description Grow Trees is more than just a tree-planting initiative. We are a movement dedicated to restoring the green cover of our planet, one tree at a time. Grow Trees is a social enterprise founded by Mr. Pradip Shah (Founder of CRISIL and founding member of HDFC). Our initiatives are trusted by more than 1,600 international enterprises such as Mercedes, HSBC, Michelin, and Pepsi. We have created over 1.8 million workdays of employment for rural/ tribal communities and have planted 23+ million trees, which will absorb 360 million kgs of CO2 per year when mature. Our commitment is to support local communities, foster biodiversity, and combat climate change. Join us and be a part of this transformative journey toward a sustainable future.For more information, please refer to our website : www.grow-trees.com Role Description As our Senior Content Writer, you will craft the narrative that inspires individuals and corporations to plant millions of trees across the globe. You will own our brand voice across digital and print platforms, translating complex environmental restoration work into compelling, high-converting content — from thought leadership on LinkedIn to editorial features, annual reports, and customer success stories. Key ResponsibilitiesSocial Media Copywriting & Creative Strategy● LinkedIn: Draft sharp, authoritative, and data-driven posts for our corporate audience (CSR heads, HR leaders, ESG managers) to drive B2B partnerships.● Instagram: Write punchy, creative captions, reel scripts, and carousel text that break down eco- concepts and highlight project impact for a broader community.● Other social media platforms: Adapt to the requirements of other social media platforms and write competing content to spread awareness and convert into sales.Editorial & Educational Content● Author SEO-optimized blogs, articles, and whitepapers on reforestation, ESG trends, climate action, and biodiversity.● Write and coordinate the organization's annual report, translating impact data and project milestones into a compelling, stakeholder-ready narrative.● Develop project page write-ups for individual plantation sites, capturing location-specific context, community impact, and ecological outcomes.● Produce transparent impact reports and storytelling pieces covering specific planting sites and community benefits.● Produce customer success case studies highlighting corporate and individual partnerships, quantifiable outcomes, and testimonials.● Source and verify information quickly and accurately from credible, authoritative channels.Email Marketing & Direct Outreach● Concept and write monthly newsletters for corporate clients, individual donors, and gift-a-tree customers.● Craft high-converting sales outreach emails, pitch decks, and follow-up collateral for prospective B2B partners.Brand Communications● Write web copy, landing pages, certificate text, and PR releases as needed.● Maintain consistency in tone, voice, and positioning across every customer touchpoint. Skills & Competencies required:● Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.● Highly creative and a self-starter.● Strong proficiency in MS Office tools — Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or equivalent.● Solid grasp of content marketing fundamentals — SEO, digital advertising, and social media marketing.● High willingness and enthusiasm to collaborate cross-functionally and drive creative innovation.● Strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple deliverables under deadlines.● Proven track record of growing or engaging audiences on LinkedIn and Instagram.● Strong command of both B2B and B2C writing styles and nuances.● Excellent command of language, grammar, and editorial judgment.● Hands-on experience with content management systems, Google Workspace (like WordPress), and grammar/editing platforms (Grammarly or others).● Switching effortlessly between casual social media captions, authoritative B2B LinkedIn posts, and formal whitepapers.Requirements:● Minimum 4 years of professional writing experience (agency, high-growth startup, or impact sector).● Bachelor's degree/diploma in Journalism or Mass Communication, or a related field.● Portfolio showcasing social media campaigns, long-form blogs, and email newsletters with metrics demonstrating previous success (e.g., organic traffic growth, high engagement rates, lead generation).● Prior experience in the social impact, climate action, sustainability, or environmental sector is a plus, but not mandatory.Be the change agent who drives our mission forward, ensuring a greener and more sustainable world for future generations. Apply now and lead the way!

title: Medical Writer
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai

**Experience:**
1–5 Years

**About Havas Life Mumbai**

Havas Life Mumbai is part of the global Havas Health Network, delivering strategic healthcare and wellness communications for leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare brands. We combine science, creativity, and innovation to create impactful campaigns for healthcare professionals and patients.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Medical Writer**
with
**1–5 years of experience**
in
**medical writing and medico-marketing**
. The ideal candidate should have a strong scientific background and the ability to translate complex medical information into engaging, accurate content for healthcare communications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop medical and promotional content for HCPs and patients.
* Create content for visual aids, brochures, presentations, digital campaigns, emailers, and websites.
* Interpret scientific literature and clinical data into clear, compliant communication.
* Ensure medical accuracy and adherence to regulatory guidelines.
* Collaborate with creative, strategy, and client servicing teams.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Medicine, Dentistry, or a related healthcare field.
* 1–5 years of experience in medical writing and medico-marketing.
* Experience in a healthcare communication agency, pharmaceutical company, or medical communications firm.
* Excellent scientific writing, editing, and communication skills.
* Familiarity with clinical literature, referencing, and healthcare marketing.
* Knowledge of AI tools for content creation is an added advantage.

**About Havas India**

Havas India gathers the expertise of 20 agencies and specialized divisions across 3 verticals:

1. Havas Media Network – Havas Media, PivotRoots (integrated digital), Arena Media, Havas Media Tribes (out-of-home), Havas Market (e-commerce), Havas Play (sports, entertainment & content), Havas Programmatic Hub (programmatic trading desk), Havas Analytics (data & analytics), Socialyse (pure play social media), and Havas Play Gameplan (sports marketing)
2. Havas Creative Network – Havas Worldwide India (creative), Havas People India (talent communications & employer branding), Havas CX India (customer experience), Think Design (UX/UI), Shobiz (experiential marketing), Shobiz Exhibits (exhibitions) Conran Design Group Mumbai (branding & design), PR Pundit Havas Red (PR), and Prose on Pixels (content-at-scale)

As one of India’s fastest growing and agile networks, Havas India has bagged multiple new clients across verticals and won several prestigious awards over the last 2 years including the group being Great Place To Work® Certified™ twice in a row (Nov 2022 - Nov 2023 & Dec 2023 – Dec 2024), consistently being featured in the top 3 at R3 New Business League rankings, and winning at Campaign Asia-Pacific Agency of the Year awards, e4m Indian Marketing Awards 2023, ABBY One Show 2023, Campaign Women Leading Change awards, and more. Our CSR programs, DE&I initiatives, and being actively involved in various industry associations are what keep us invested as a network that has a clear mission of making a meaningful difference to brands, businesses, and people.

For more information, visit https://in.havas.com/ and follow Havas India on social media.

title: Associate Business Process Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
The Associate Business Process Analyst will work closely with cross‑functional teams to shape and evolve a core product offering. Acting as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the IT development team, you will translate business needs into technical specifications, prioritize enhancements, and ensure the product remains usable, scalable, and aligned with organizational goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Elicit, document, and validate business requirements for product enhancements.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications for the development team.
* Collaborate with IT to design, develop, and test new product features.
* Analyze existing product performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Prioritize backlog items based on business impact, feasibility, and ROI.
* Facilitate communication between business users and technical teams.
* Conduct user acceptance testing and ensure solutions meet quality standards.
* Provide recommendations for process automation and efficiency gains.
* Monitor product metrics post‑release and suggest iterative refinements.
* Maintain up‑to‑date documentation and knowledge base for stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in business analysis or product support roles.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a data‑driven mindset.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management abilities.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and requirement‑tracking tools.
* Basic understanding of software development lifecycle and technical concepts.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Visio, and diagramming tools; experience with JIRA or similar is a plus.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines.
* Detail‑oriented with a focus on delivering high‑quality, user‑centric solutions.

title: Technical Support Specialist - BioPharma
description:
**About Kerry**
Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.
  
  
**About the role**
The Technical Support Specialist provides exceptional support for our BioPharmaceutical and Life Sciences product portfolios. This role involves offering expert technical support and guidance to customers, troubleshooting product issues, and ensuring customer satisfaction. Reporting to the GTS Manager - Pharma, the specialist is responsible for resolving internal and external customer technical queries promptly and effectively. The role requires prioritizing activities in a dynamic environment, allocating resources to critical projects, and assisting the global business team in driving sales and capturing new opportunities. The Specialist will play a crucial role in maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty by delivering exceptional support and service.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Inquiries Promptly address technical customer inquiries regarding the BioPharma and Life Sciences Product Portfolio, gathering appropriate responses from internal technical collateral, literature searches, and consultations with internal subject matter experts (SMEs). Recommendations provided will include product application details, product-specific technical information, and general end-use application knowledge.
* Communication Effectively communicate with Account Managers, Product Managers and other stake holders to clearly understand and meet customers’ needs.
* Collaboration Collaborate cross-functionally (with sales, RD&A, product management, marketing, process technology, regulatory, quality, etc.) to develop appropriate, customized technical responses. The candidate will communicate and work closely with product development teams to provide feedback and insights from customer interactions. Interact with a wide array of SMEs and stakeholders to aid the sales team.
* Resource Utilization Utilize available resources strategically to support account directors with technical information specific to BioPharma and Life Sciences portfolio end-uses.
* Customer Calls Support technical customer calls as needed, capturing, and sharing meeting notes; over 90% of customer calls are virtual meetings.
* Documentation Document and track customer issues using a ticketing system, ensuring accurate and detailed records. Maintain comprehensive logs of customer interactions and technical issues.
* Troubleshooting Support troubleshooting activities when application issues arise at customers, working collaboratively and cross-functionally. Activities may include, but are not limited to supporting customer calls, scheduling internal debriefs and brainstorming meetings, capturing meeting notes, requesting and submitting samples for testing, gathering data from other departments, analyzing data and preparing reports, presenting summaries to internal stakeholders and on customer calls. Conduct root cause analysis in collaboration with relevant departments to resolve technical issues, ensuring minimal disruption to customer operations.
* Training Assist in preparing and delivering training presentations to the Sales Team.
* Market Intelligence Capture Voice of Customer (VOC), capture market/industry intelligence, monitor technical queries for trends, and bring these insights forward to relevant stakeholders.
* Technical Documentation & Tools Develop and maintain technical documentation and tools for the sales team (e.g., develop/maintain FAQ list, product info tools, product matching tool, etc.).
* Industry Knowledge Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to provide informed support. Continuously enhance technical knowledge through training and professional development.
* Multitask Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining high levels of accuracy and efficiency.
* Technical Writing Create, review, and update technical documents, including user manuals, product specifications, and troubleshooting guides. Ensure clarity, accuracy, and consistency in all technical documentation.
* Marketing Support Collaborate with the marketing team to develop technical content for marketing materials, such as brochures, application notes, papers, and case studies. Provide technical insights and support for marketing campaigns and initiatives.

**Qualifications and skills**
**Qualifications**

* Education Bachelor's or Master's in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related field.
* Location - Mumbai/Gurgaon/Bangalore
* Experience Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in technical service or support within the Pharmaceutical and/or Biopharmaceutical industry. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
* Customer Relationship Management Proven track record in managing customer relationships and driving technical service excellence.
* Technical Knowledge Strong understanding of pharmaceutical products and their applications. Knowledge of unit operations and practices relevant to pharmaceutical customers and cGMP processes.
* Problem-Solving Skills Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Ability to think critically and analytically to resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication Skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users. Proficiency in written and verbal communication.
* Tools and Systems Experience with ticketing systems and remote support tools. Proficiency in using software and tools for technical support and documentation. Experience working in an SAP environment is desirable.
* Teamwork Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Strong collaboration skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Travel Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.
* Skills
* Broad scientific knowledge base with a focus on microbial and biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Comfortable bridging R&D and Commercial enterprises to help reach organizational goals.
* Collaborative individual, adept at working with cross-functional teams within a matrix organization.
* Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills to meet delivery on competing priorities.
* Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication, and presentation skills.
* Works independently, takes ownership of the role, is proactive and self-motivated.
* Agile individual, comfortable working in an ambiguous setting.
* Proficiency in Outlook, Excel/Word/PowerPoint, CRM software (preferred), JMP/Minitab/SPSS (preferred) and technical writing software’s
* Strong understanding and vigilance of confidentiality of both Kerry and customer IP.
* Able to travel independently and present technical information at trade shows and customer meetings.
* Excels at working in a diverse environment.

title: Biomedical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Biomedical Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in biomedical engineering principles and a passion for improving healthcare through technology. The Portfolio Support Specialist supports Brennan’s Digital Group professional services business across the Cloud, Data & AI and Business Applications practices. Reporting to the Digital Group Portfolio Manager, the role improves portfolio visibility, PPM adoption, data quality and operational discipline across Brennan’s project and portfolio management processes.
  
  
The role is expected to consistently use available AI tools to improve speed, accuracy and efficiency across PPM support, reporting, analysis, training material maintenance and continual improvement activities. This is not a traditional manual administration role; the successful candidate will proactively reduce repetitive effort, identify patterns, streamline tasks and use AI to deliver faster, more reliable portfolio support outcomes.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
**Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) Tool End-user Support**

* Provide first level support to end users of Brennan’s Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) tool, including how-to guidance, navigation support and assistance with day-to-day usage queries.
* Support onboarding of new starters by delivering basic PPM tool training and helping users understand required processes, data entry standards and project information hygiene expectations.
* Own, maintain and continually improve PPM training materials, including user guides, FAQs, work instructions and training handbooks.
* Troubleshoot level 1 PPM tool issues, triage user queries, capture recurring problems and escalate system or process issues where additional support is required.
* Use available AI tools to identify recurring PPM support issues, improve guidance materials and reduce repetitive user support effort.

**Service Pack Coordination**

* Coordinate a portfolio of small, simple service packs that do not require client-facing project management, ensuring delivery information remains accurate and current.
* Maintain service pack updates in Brennan’s PPM tool, including status, key dates, assigned resources, progress notes and closure information.
* Ensure resource planning tools are updated to reflect resource allocation, planned effort and delivery timing against each service pack.
* Monitor service pack progress and follow up with delivery resources or internal stakeholders to confirm updates, identify blockers and support timely completion.
* Maintain consistent information hygiene across service pack records so portfolio reporting, resource planning and operational visibility remain reliable.

**Digital Group Portfolio Manager Support**

* Provide ad-hoc support to the Digital Group Portfolio Manager across portfolio reporting, data analysis, administration and operational follow-up activities.
* Assist with preparing portfolio reports, dashboards, summaries and analysis using information from PPM, resource planning and other delivery management tools.
* Use available AI tools to identify recurring support themes, data quality gaps, reporting inconsistencies and process inefficiencies, then translate insights into practical improvement actions.
* Proactively identify continual improvement opportunities and maintain a backlog of initiatives to improve ways of working, system usage, data quality and portfolio support processes.
* Maintain all project management guidelines, playbooks and templates, ensuring the latest versions are available and accessible to all PMs.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**

* Communicate clearly with PPM users, delivery teams, project managers and practice stakeholders to support accurate tool usage and timely updates.
* Respond to PPM user queries, provide simple guidance and escalate issues where further support is required.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to keep service pack status, resource allocation and delivery information current.
* Use available AI tools to summarise support activity, service pack progress, blockers, data quality issues and recurring stakeholder themes into clear updates for the Digital Group Portfolio Manager.
* Maintain clear records of requests, actions, decisions and outcomes to support reporting and follow-up.

**Key Competencies And Qualifications Required**

* 5+ years’ experience working in portfolio, PMO, project coordination, project administration or professional services support environments, preferably within a technology services business.
* Demonstrated exposure to portfolio-level ways of working, including project governance, status reporting, data quality, resource planning, templates, playbooks and operational follow-up.
* Experience supporting users of project, portfolio or resource planning tools, including responding to how-to queries, assisting new users, maintaining training materials and troubleshooting basic issues.
* Experience maintaining accurate project, portfolio or operational data in tools and trackers, with strong attention to data quality, status updates, information hygiene and reporting accuracy.
* Exposure to resource planning, scheduling, capacity tracking or allocation management across multiple small work packages, projects or service activities.
* Experience working with geographically distributed stakeholders, with the ability to follow up actions, communicate clearly, manage competing priorities and escalate issues when required.
* Mandatory Skills and Technology
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project Operations is mandatory, including project setup, project records, tasks, resource assignments, time or effort visibility, status information, reporting inputs and data quality management.
* Strong administration, coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to maintain accurate records, track actions and keep portfolio information current.
* Confident supporting business users with project, portfolio and resource planning tools, including providing simple guidance, basic training and level 1 troubleshooting.
* Strong attention to detail and data quality, with the ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies or missing updates in PPM and resource planning tools.
* Proven ability to consistently use available AI tools to improve speed, accuracy and efficiency across reporting, analysis, support triage, documentation maintenance and continual improvement activities.
* Ability to own, maintain and continually improve user guides, FAQs, work instructions, training handbooks, PM guidelines, artefacts, playbooks and templates.

**Highly Desired Skills and Technology**

* Confident using Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Planner, to support communication, reporting, tracking and administration.
* Intermediate Excel skills, with the ability to work with lists, filters, tables and basic reporting outputs to support portfolio analysis and data quality checks.
* Basic exposure to reporting or dashboard tools, such as Power BI, to support portfolio reporting, analysis and data quality checks.
* Ability to log, prioritise, track and follow up support requests through to resolution or escalation.
* Basic understanding of project lifecycle, resource planning, scheduling and reporting concepts required to support service pack coordination and portfolio visibility.

Full Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a senior
**Power Systems & Renewable Energy Specialist**
with deep expertise in renewable grid integration, dynamic modeling, Power Plant Controllers (PPCs), inverter-based resources (IBRs), grid-code compliance, and real-time Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring a combination of
**power-system engineering, renewable-energy integration, control-system development, simulation, and technical project leadership**
experience. This role will work across utility-scale Solar PV, Wind, BESS, and hybrid renewable-energy projects, partnering with utilities, transmission operators, OEMs, inverter manufacturers, EPCs, and project developers
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead power-system engineering, renewable-energy integration, and grid-compliance activities for utility-scale Solar PV, Wind, BESS, and hybrid renewable-energy projects.
* Provide technical leadership for Power Plant Controller (PPC), inverter control, and plant-level active/reactive power control solutions.
* Lead grid-integration and interconnection studies, including steady-state, dynamic, transient, contingency, and system-stability analysis.
* Develop, validate, and maintain power-system models using PSS/E, PSCAD/EMTDC, and other industry-standard simulation tools.
* Develop and validate dynamic and user-defined models for renewable plants, inverters, and PPCs.
* Design and validate PPC and inverter control strategies for normal operating conditions and grid disturbances, including voltage/frequency control and fault ride-through (FRT) requirements.
* Lead HIL testing and real-time simulation using platforms such as RTDS and OPAL-RT for inverter and PPC validation.
* Assess weak-grid and low-SCR conditions, voltage stability, dynamic performance, and controller interactions.
* Lead grid-code compliance assessments and validate performance through simulation and real-time testing.
* Coordinate technical activities across OEMs, inverter manufacturers, PPC suppliers, utilities, EPC contractors, and project owners.
* Lead technical discussions with utilities and transmission-system operators on grid interconnection, stability, protection, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Define technical requirements, review engineering deliverables, and ensure technical quality throughout project execution.
* Support projects from proposal and study definition through engineering, validation, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to power-system engineers and project teams.
* Contribute to research and development, new modeling methodologies, and advanced renewable-grid integration solutions.

**Essential Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in power-system engineering and renewable-energy grid integration.
* Advanced proficiency in PSS/E.
* Strong experience with PSCAD/EMTDC and EMT/dynamic simulation.
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink for control-system development and analysis.
* Experience developing and validating dynamic and user-defined models.
* Strong understanding of inverter-based resources, PPCs, grid-forming/grid-following controls, and renewable plant controls.
* Experience with grid-code requirements, interconnection studies, and system stability analysis.
* Programming experience in Fortran and/or C for model development and customization.
* Experience working with utilities, transmission operators, OEMs, or renewable-energy developers.

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

* Experience with RTDS / RSCAD and/or OPAL-RT.
* Experience with PowerWorld.
* Hands-on experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Experience with weak-grid, low-SCR, voltage stability, and controller-interaction studies.
* Experience with BESS and hybrid renewable-energy systems.
* Experience leading technical projects or multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, scopes of work, and engineering studies.
* Experience in research, development, and implementation of advanced power-system technologies.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate complex power-system challenges into practical engineering solutions.
* Strong technical communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with customers, utilities, OEMs, and engineering teams.
* Ability to lead technical projects independently while mentoring and developing other engineers.
* A collaborative, hands-on approach to solving complex renewable-energy and grid-integration challenges.

Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**

We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**

description:
**Biochemist – AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
What if your expertise in protein folding, enzyme kinetics, or metabolic pathways could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI models think about science?
  
  
Alignerr partners with leading AI research labs to build and refine cutting-edge language models — and we need PhD-level Biochemists to help us get the science right. This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your deep domain knowledge becomes the benchmark for AI accuracy.
  
  
No AI background required. Just bring your scientific rigor.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Expert-Level Problems — Craft advanced biochemistry challenges spanning nucleic acid chemistry, proteomics, structural biology, and drug-target interactions to stress-test AI reasoning.
* Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step scientific responses that serve as the gold standard for AI model training and benchmarking.
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated biochemical pathways, molecular structures, and quantitative analyses for technical accuracy, logical consistency, and scientific soundness.
* Refine AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in AI thinking — such as incorrect stoichiometry, stereochemical errors, or flawed metabolic logic — and provide structured, actionable feedback to improve model performance.

**Who You Are**

* PhD-level expertise: You hold (or are in the final stages of completing) a PhD in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a closely related discipline.
* Deep domain knowledge: You have strong command of at least one core area — structural biology, enzymology, cellular metabolism, bioinformatics, or molecular genetics.
* Precise communicator: You can translate highly technical biochemical concepts into clear, well-structured written explanations.
* Detail-oriented: You catch errors others miss — whether it's a miscalculated Km value or an incorrect stereocenter assignment.
* No AI experience required — we'll give you everything you need to get started.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or scientific peer review
* Familiarity with computational tools such as PyMOL, AlphaFold, or BLAST
* Background in science writing, technical documentation, or curriculum development

**Why Join Us**

* Make a real impact — Your scientific expertise directly improves how AI reasons about life sciences, with implications for research worldwide.
* Work on the frontier — Get hands-on exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated.
* Total flexibility — Work on your own schedule, fully remote, with no fixed hours or location requirements.
* Autonomy — Choose your own pace and projects that align with your expertise.
* Ongoing opportunity — Strong contributors are considered for contract extensions and additional projects.

title: Technical Customer Support Professional II
description:
**Empower Structural Innovation as a Technical Support Professional – Tekla Structures (Concrete, Precast, & Rebar)**
Are you a customer-focused structural professional who loves deconstructing complex software challenges? Trimble is seeking a high-caliber Technical Support Professional to join our dedicated Customer Support network. In this high-impact position, you will serve as the premier point of contact for enterprise clients navigating advanced workflows within
**Tekla Structures**
, specifically focusing on the Concrete, Precast, and Rebar modules. Your immediate technical expertise will ensure engineering and detailing teams around the world minimize downtime and achieve structural precision.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**Our Product Ecosystem:**
Tekla software solutions are the global standard for advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM) and structural engineering. From massive cast-in-place concrete structures to complex precast components and high-density reinforcement detailing, Tekla drives structural lifecycle efficiency from design to the job site.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this role, you will transition from a day-to-day detailer or modeller into a highly valued structural subject matter expert. Operating within our state-of-the-art hubs in Chennai or Navi Mumbai, you will have the technical autonomy to reverse-engineer software anomalies, troubleshoot localized configurations, and configure cross-platform cloud integrations. You will work closely with global helpdesks and act as a crucial voice-of-the-customer, directly collaborating with Trimble’s Product Development teams to advocate for product updates and eliminate architectural bottlenecks.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Complex Modeling Resolution: Provide clear, step-by-step technical guidance to resolve advanced structural modeling and parametric geometry issues faced by global engineering accounts.
* Database & Catalog Orchestration: Manage, audit, and troubleshoot intricate software databases, custom reinforcement catalogs, and automated Bar Bending Schedules (BBS).
* Deliverable Configuration Support: Assist detailers in configuring and optimizing General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Cast Unit drawings, automated rebar schedules, and custom Template Editor (.tpl) reports.
* Environment Architecture Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve localized company environment bugs, including custom parametric components, complex drawing layouts, custom attributes, and enterprise firm/project folder paths.
* Cloud & Interoperability Engineering: Support collaborative cloud workspaces by resolving interoperability bottlenecks across Trimble Connect, Tekla Model Sharing, and open BIM data exchanges (IFC, DWG, DXF, BVBS).
* Bug Replication & Product Escalation: Systematically replicate user-reported software errors, document system limitations, and escalate unresolved code defects to global development teams while populating internal knowledge bases.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Professional Experience: 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience utilizing or supporting Tekla Structures. Highly preferred experience operating within an RCC, Precast detailing, or high-fidelity BIM production environment.
* Technical Deep-Dive Mastery: Complete mastery of Tekla Structures software functionality, system configurations, directory folders, detailing standards, and reinforcement modules.
* Diagnostic Capabilities: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with a proven capability to investigate system logs, reverse-engineer software errors, and troubleshoot severe system crashes under pressure.
* Communication & Deadline Focus: Exceptional, patient, and highly professional written and verbal communication skills to deliver technical solutions clearly to users working under strict engineering deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.

**Bonus Points For**

* Workflow Automation Tooling: Practical knowledge or script exposure to Tekla Open API, C#, or Grasshopper for parametric workflow automation.
* Advanced Component Customization: Direct experience developing complex parametric Custom Components and custom software macros.
* Cross-Domain Competency: Prior structural background or foundational workflow knowledge in structural steel detailing and fabrication logic.

**Logistics**

* Locations: Chennai or Navi Mumbai, India
* Department: Customer Support / Technical Services
* Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
  
  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

**How to Apply:**
Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.
  
  
**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.
  
  
Candidate Privacy Notices by Country
  
  
If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

title: Customer Support Associate - Technical 2nd Line
description:
**About ZDHC**
The ZDHC Foundation develops and implements the Roadmap to Zero Programme with a focus on reducing the chemical footprint of the Fashion Industry. We are the leading sustainability organisation driving sustainable chemistry, innovations and best practices in textile, apparel, leather and footwear manufacturing to protect consumers, workers and the environment. Through collaborative engagement, alignment and large-scale implementation, we take a holistic approach to sustainable chemical management and enable tangible progress in the wider industry through the delivery of guidelines, platforms and solutions, including capacity-building and innovation projects. For more information about ZDHC, see www.roadmaptozero.com and follow us on LinkedIn.
  
  
**ZDHC Vision and Mission**
The ZDHC Vision is a World in which better chemistry leads to the protection of life, land, air and water. The ZDHC Mission is to lead our global value chain to achieve the highest standard for sustainable chemical management, driving resource efficiency and circularity.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The
**Customer Support Associate – Technical 2nd Line**
provides specialised technical support within the Customer Support Team, acting as the link between first-line Customer Support and the Platform Development Team.
  
  
The role investigates and resolves technical issues escalated by first-line support or other internal teams, ensuring that issues are accurately analysed, documented, prioritised and followed through to resolution. Working closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team, the role supports effective bug management, platform testing and the successful release of new functionalities and enhancements.
  
  
Through hands-on investigation, structured testing and close collaboration across teams, the role contributes to a reliable, user-friendly platform and a high-quality customer experience. The role is intended for candidates who combine strong customer-support capabilities with a genuine software development mindset.
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Second-Line Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide second-line technical support for platform-related questions and issues escalated by first-line Customer Support and other internal teams.
* Investigate reported technical issues to understand and reproduce problems, distinguish between user-related issues and potential platform bugs, and identify possible root causes.
* Resolve technical support cases independently where possible and escalate issues requiring development support to the appropriate team.
* Identify recurring technical issues and patterns and proactively flag opportunities to improve platform functionality, user experience or support processes.

**Technical Skills & Platform Development Capabilities**

* Apply a strong technical understanding of modern web-based applications, including APIs, databases, authentication flows, application architecture and common integration patterns.
* Use practical development skills and experience with at least one modern programming language or web development framework to support technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, including reading and understanding source code.
* Investigate complex technical issues using browser developer tools, application logs, API requests and responses, database queries and other relevant debugging tools.
* Work closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team to clarify technical issues and support effective prioritisation and resolution.

**Bug Management, Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Create clear and complete technical tickets, including issue descriptions, reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, supporting evidence and relevant user information.
* Track technical issues and bugs through to resolution and ensure relevant stakeholders are kept informed of progress and outcomes.
* Support the testing of new platform functionalities, features, enhancements and bug fixes before and after release.
* Conduct structured functional and regression testing and clearly document testing results, issues and observations.
* Verify resolved bugs and fixes before tickets are closed and confirm that the expected functionality is working correctly.

**Knowledge Sharing & Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Translate technical findings into clear and understandable information for first-line Customer Support and other non-technical colleagues.
* Support the development and maintenance of internal troubleshooting guidance, technical support documentation and relevant Knowledge Base content.
* Collaborate closely with Customer Support, Platform Development and other relevant teams to ensure an effective flow of information between users and technical teams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant education or equivalent professional experience in customer support, technical support, IT, digital platforms or a related field.
* Previous experience in customer support, technical support, application support, software testing or a comparable role.
* Experience working with web-based platforms, software applications or digital products.
* Experience investigating and troubleshooting technical issues and translating findings into clear, actionable tickets.
* Experience with ticketing, issue-tracking or development tools; experience with tools such as Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Asana or similar is an advantage.
* Experience with functional software testing, bug reproduction and/or regression testing is an advantage.
* Strong digital literacy and the ability to quickly understand new systems, functionalities and technical processes.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues and translate between customer/user issues and technical requirements.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience working in an international and cross-functional environment is an advantage.

**Competencies**

* Accountability — Take responsibility for actions and results, stay accountable for successes and failures, and ensure commitments and standards are met.
* Attention to Detail — Produce and review work carefully for accuracy, completeness, and consistency to ensure high standards.
* Communication — Share information, ideas, and expectations clearly and persuasively, and adapt style and content to the audience for understanding and impact.
* Customer Orientation — Understand, anticipate, and meet customer needs through empathy, effective communication, and responsiveness aligned with customer priorities.
* Problem-Solving — Anticipate and define problems, analyse root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical, timely actions to resolve issues effectively.
* Software-Specific Competencies — Learn and apply relevant software and digital tools effectively to support processes, data management, and decision-making.
* Teamwork — Work cooperatively with others, communicate openly, support colleagues, manage conflict constructively, and focus on shared goals for collective results.

**What We Offer**
At ZDHC, we believe that a fulfilling career goes beyond a competitive salary. We are committed to creating a supportive and inspiring workplace where you feel valued, energised, and empowered to do your best work. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your growth, help you achieve your goals, and encourage strong connections with your team.
  
  

* 30 holidays a year, based on 40 hours a week
* Gym membership allowance - for your physical wellbeing
* Access to Open Up - for your mental wellbeing
* Hybrid and flexible working environment
* Support in setting up your workstation at home (if needed)
* High-speed internet costs reimbursed
* Working abroad development experience - the opportunity to work abroad from one of our offices for 1-3 months (after 1 year)
* MacBook and iphone

In addition, there are regional benefits, depending on the location of hire. Those will be discussed during the interview process.
  
  
Want to make an impact? Join a small, multicultural and purpose-driven team at a pivotal moment for ZDHC. You’ll help shape the evolution of the Roadmap to Zero Programme and drive meaningful change across the global textile and footwear sector, working collaboratively with colleagues across cultures, locations and time zones through remote and online ways of working.
  
  
**IMPORTANT NOTE**
**Our preference is for a candidate living and working in Thane/Mumbai. This hiring process does not include visa sponsorship or a relocation package.**
**To apply: Please submit your CV and a 1-page motivation letter in PDF.**

What You Will Do

title: Specialist, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (Health Care Sector) - Mumbai/Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist – Health Care Sector Research – Center for Health Solutions – Research & Insights**
The Deloitte Center for Health Solutions is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (MI&I) group, focusing primarily on the Life Sciences & Health Care industry. The Center's goals are:
  
  

* Deloitte Center for Health Solutions (DCHS) is Deloitte’s trusted source for actionable insights on the most pressing issues in life sciences and health care.
* Our mission is to turn evidence into influence—delivering research that challenges conventional wisdom, sparks dialogue and drives transformation across the health ecosystem.
* The Center brings together researchers, policy experts, and strategists to generate differentiated, data-driven thought leadership.
* As part of Deloitte’s Research & Insights organization within the Clients, Strategy and Growth function, DCHS works at the intersection of commercial, public sector, academic, and business to help our clients, and the world, make smarter, more sustainable decisions about health.

Learn more about the Center and have a peek into our work here – Deloitte Center for Health Solutions .
  
  
This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the health care sector across health providers and health insurers subsectors. Our Center focuses on key topics and campaigns including AI and tech-enabled transformation, care model transformation, workforce productivity, consumer engagement, and more.
  
  
The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in the health care sector, with a focus on health providers and health insurers subsectors that include topics like affordability and cost of care, AI and tech-enabled transformation, care delivery transformation, patient experience and engagement, strategic margin growth, M&A and strategic partnerships, and the US regulatory and policy landscape (340B changes, Medicaid reform, Medicare rate updates, price transparency, AI-governance etc.). These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Specialist focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
  
  

* Work across diverse health care sector topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals.
* Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities.
* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.
* Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.
* Identify and apply relevant analytical methods, partnering with data science and analytics professionals to derive actionable insights from large, complex datasets (Capital IQ, Pitchbook, Alphasense, Mergermarket, FDA, CMS datasets, O\*NET, KFF, public company filings) in support of health care research and business priorities.
* Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports.
* Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.
* Support all aspects of engagement/project to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines.
* Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.
* Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings.

**Experience**
**Requisite experience and skills**

* 3-6 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects in health care topic areas.
* Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.

**Industry/sector/subsector Skills**

* Business research/thought leadership development experience in the health care sector is preferred.
* Knowledge of U.S. health care sector, including key trends across providers, insurers, related health care segments, as well as impact of policy, and regulatory forces on the industry, is preferred.
* Familiarity with the impact of AI, advanced analytics, and other emerging technologies on health care business models, operations, workforce, care delivery will be an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Sound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research.
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data-driven insights.
* Ability to use statistical and advanced data analysis methods to analyze large and complex datasets, including surveys.
* Ability to develop compelling and analytical data visualizations using one or more tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or others.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills. Journalistic and narrative writing style is preferred, along with prior experience in report writing and research report development.
* Problem-solving and critical thinking skills to generate meaningful analytical insights.
* Broad understanding of strategy models and frameworks, and the ability to apply them to research problems.
* Ability to understand the impact of marketplace changes on the industry, sector, or sub-sector.
* Proficiency in using generative AI-based platforms and tools to elevate research discovery, data insights, analytical rigor, and business writing.
* Proficiency in using generative AI and related tools to identify early signals and trends shaping the market through continuous sensing will be preferred.
* Familiarity with building custom GPTs and custom gen-AI research tools will be an added advantage.

**The broader Deloitte Research and Insights team**
The Deloitte Research and Insights teams’ mission is to conduct research and analysis to develop compelling, forward-looking perspectives that enable clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The team plays an integral role in strengthening the firm’s strategic positioning by developing high-quality thoughtware from end to end, published on Deloitte Insights and Deloitte.com.
  
  
Their work includes:
  
  

* Managing relations with internal stakeholders.
* Using advanced data science and survey advisory capabilities to strengthen the credibility of insights.
* Using editorial and visualization capabilities to improve the stickiness of firm thoughtware.

**Qualifications, experience, work location, and timing**
Academic qualification: Master’s Degree like MBA, PGDM, Economics, Business Economics
  
  
Work experience: 3-6 years
  
  
Location: Hyderabad/Mumbai
  
  
Work hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: SEO Content Writer
description:
We are looking for a results driven SEO Content Writing Specialist who can create high-quality, user-centric and search-optimised content across blogs, landing pages and website pages. The ideal candidate should understand search intent, keyword strategy and conversion-focused writing.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. SEO Content Creation**

* Write and optimise blog articles, website pages and landing pages
* Create content aligned with SEO best practices (on-page SEO, keyword placement, internal linking)
* Deliver high-quality, plagiarism-free and engaging content

**2. Keyword Research & Content Planning**

* Conduct keyword research using tools like SEMrush, and Google Keyword Planner
* Identify primary, secondary and long-tail keywords
* Build content calendars aligned with SEO and business goals

**3. On-Page SEO Optimization**

* Optimise meta titles, descriptions, headings (H1–H6) and content structure
* Ensure proper use of schema, internal linking, and keyword density
* Improve existing content for better rankings (content refresh strategy)

**4. User-Centric & Conversion-Focused Writing**

* Write content that is not only SEO-friendly but also drives engagement and conversions
* Align content with different stages of the funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)
* Maintain brand tone and consistency

**5. Competitor & SERP Analysis**

* Conduct competitor content analysis
* Identify content gaps and opportunities
* Optimize content for featured snippets and SERP features

**Required Skills:**

* Strong writing and editing skills in English
* Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals
* Ability to simplify complex financial concepts
* Experience in writing long-form and short-form content

**About Kissht:**

Kissht is India's leading listed fintech companies, offering fast, personalized digital credit through its mobile app to customers across the country. Founded in 2016 by IIT/IIM alumni Ranvir Singh and Krishnan Vishwanathan, both former McKinsey consultants, Kissht was listed on the NSE and BSE in May 2026.

Kissht serves 74.6 million registered users and 12.25 million customers, with assets under management (AUM) of approximately ₹8,000 crore. Its growth is powered by proprietary AI/ML-based underwriting, a robust in-house technology stack, and a pan-India collections network.Headquartered in Mumbai and backed by marquee investors, including the Brunei InvestmentAuthority, Vertex Growth Fund, and the Government of Singapore, Kissht is now scaling as a publiccompany and is looking for driven, entrepreneurial talent to join nits next phase of growth.

We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what is important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
  
  
This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Automation, Reinvention and Collaboration (ARC) team is part of Parametric Operations. The Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team designs, builds, tests, and delivers enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda-based workflow platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
Parametric is seeking an Associate to join the Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team to support the design, build, testing, and delivery of enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda-based workflow platform.
  
  
The role is a hands-on workflow practitioner who translates complex operational processes into clear requirements and executable workflows. Working with Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and platform teams, the role supports the full workflow lifecycle from discovery and BPMN/DMN modelling through testing, deployment readiness and production support. The role requires practical process analysis, attention to controls and exceptions, and a willingness to develop deeper Camunda expertise.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* ­Discover and define workflows: Lead or support discovery sessions; document business objectives, triggers, actors, systems, data, controls, handoffs, SLAs, decisions and exception scenarios; translate incomplete processes into structured, testable requirements.
* ­ Model executable processes: Design end-to-end BPMN 2.0 workflows and DMN decision logic, including user and service tasks, events, gateways, subprocesses, approvals, escalations, retries, rework and manual-intervention paths.
* ­Configure Workflow Center solutions: Configure models, forms, variables, business rules, task assignments and approved platform components; partner with engineers to define service interactions, APIs, data mappings and integration dependencies.
* ­Support end-to-end delivery: Contribute from intake and design through functional testing, UAT, deployment readiness, hypercare and production analysis; prepare test scenarios, investigate defects and maintain delivery and operating documentation.
* ­Embed controls and operational resilience: Model maker-checker controls, evidence requirements, rejection and resubmission, attestations, auditability and exception handling; escalate unclear requirements, conflicting rules and unresolved risks.
* ­Collaborate and communicate: Facilitate workshops and model walkthroughs; explain workflow behaviour in business language; provide concise updates on progress, decisions, dependencies, risks and defects.
* ­ Apply standards and promote reuse: Follow BPMN, DMN, documentation, testing, naming and review standards; use and improve reusable patterns, templates, checklists and playbooks.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related area of study.
* 4+ years of professional experience in workflow modelling, business process management, process automation, business analysis, operations transformation or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience creating executable BPMN 2.0 models, with a sound understanding of events, tasks, gateways, subprocesses, messages, timers, boundary events and exception paths.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate complex or incomplete operational processes into structured models, decision logic and clear documentation.
* Understanding operational controls, approvals, handoffs, task assignment, SLAs, auditability and exception management.
* Experience preparing test scenarios, documenting defects and supporting functional testing or UAT.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage assigned work, raise risks early and collaborate with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Camunda 8, Camunda Modeler or another executable workflow platform, including BPMN, DMN, forms, variables or connectors.
* Familiarity with FEEL, REST APIs, JSON, events, messaging, SQL or enterprise-system integrations.
* Experience with Jira and Confluence and with reviewing workflow instances, variables, incidents, logs or execution paths.
* Financial-services or other regulated-industry experience; exposure to onboarding, oversight, reconciliation, approvals, investment operations or exception management.
* BPMN, Camunda, business analysis or process-management training or certification

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our business.
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. * Support Quality digital system enhancements, upgrades, and releases in coordination with system owners and Digital/IT teams.

* Quality practitioners and auditors.

* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Challenging Problems — Develop advanced environmental engineering scenarios across contaminant transport, mass balance in treatment systems, hydrology, LCA, and more
* Author Gold-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions — from chemical dosage calculations to hydraulic flow models — that serve as the benchmark for AI responses
* Audit AI Outputs — Critically evaluate AI-generated remediation plans, environmental impact statements, and engineering calculations for technical accuracy, safety, and regulatory compliance (EPA, ISO 14001, etc.)
* Sharpen AI Reasoning — Identify flawed logic in AI responses — such as incorrect stoichiometry, missing secondary impacts, or improper unit conversions — and provide structured feedback to improve how models think

**Who You Are**

* Pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering (environmental focus), or a closely related field
* Strong foundational knowledge in at least one of: aquatic chemistry, wastewater process design, air quality engineering, or hazardous waste remediation
* Able to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and precisely in writing
* Detail-oriented — you catch unit conversion errors, broken stoichiometry, and regulatory gaps that others miss
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or evaluation frameworks
* Familiarity with environmental modeling software (e.g., AERMOD, EPANET, SimaPro)

**Why Join Us**

* Work at the frontier of AI development alongside top research teams
* Fully remote and asynchronous — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance flexibility with the potential for ongoing contract work
* Rare opportunity to apply deep technical expertise in a high-impact, non-traditional role
* Contribute to AI systems that will reason about real-world environmental challenges

title: Biology Subject Matter Expert - AI Content Specialist
description:
**Biology Subject Matter Expert (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
We're looking for biology experts to help evaluate and improve AI systems trained on advanced scientific content. Your knowledge will directly shape how AI understands, reasons through, and communicates complex biology — from molecular mechanisms to systems-level concepts.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of life science and artificial intelligence, contributing to some of the most cutting-edge AI research happening today — no prior AI experience needed.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design challenging, advanced biology problems and questions to rigorously test AI performance
* Develop clear, step-by-step solutions with sound scientific logic and reasoning
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and quality of reasoning
* Identify errors, misconceptions, or gaps in AI responses across biology topics
* Collaborate with researchers to refine benchmarks spanning undergraduate through Masters-level biology
* Provide structured, actionable feedback that drives measurable improvements in AI models

**Who You Are**

* Pursuing or completed a Master's degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a closely related field
* Strong command of advanced biology concepts with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
* Able to communicate complex scientific ideas clearly and precisely in writing
* Detail-oriented with a systematic approach to evaluating quality and accuracy
* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in an asynchronous environment
* No prior AI experience required

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or evaluation frameworks
* Familiarity with how large language models (LLMs) work
* Background spanning multiple biology subdisciplines (e.g., cell biology, genetics, physiology, biochemistry)

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects with world-leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: high autonomy, variety of tasks, and global collaboration
* Directly influence how AI handles advanced scientific reasoning
* Potential for ongoing work and contract renewals

title: Application Engineer – Drill Bits
description:
**Would you like to help customers improve drilling performance and economics through innovative drill-bit solutions?**
**Are you an engineering graduate ready to start or grow your career in application engineering?**
**Partner with the best**
Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company. We provide innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the energy value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, we combine deep industry expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With more than a century of experience, we partner with customers across oil and gas, industrial, and emerging energy markets to help advance a more sustainable energy future.
  
  
**Fuel your passion**
As an Application Engineer for Drill Bits, you will provide technical and application support to customers and internal teams. You will use engineering analysis, field data, and collaborative problem-solving to recommend drill-bit solutions, improve drilling performance, and support business growth. This role is suitable for a fresh engineering graduate or an early-career professional who is eager to learn and develop within the drill-bit industry.
  
  
As an Application Engineer, you will be responsible for:
  
  
  

* Providing technical support for drill-bit products and applications
* Supporting the implementation of product strategies, engineering standards, and best practices across the assigned market and the wider Asia-Pacific region
* Working with the sales team to develop account strategies, identify opportunities, and support profitable growth
* Preparing drill-bit proposals, application engineering studies, design recommendations, drilling-parameter guidance, and vibration-mitigation recommendations
* Analyzing drilling data and product performance to identify opportunities for performance improvement
* Collaborating with customers and Baker Hughes design engineers to adapt existing products or develop new designs for specific applications
* Investigating unusual or unsatisfactory product performance, identifying root causes, and recommending preventive and corrective actions
* Supporting field activities and visiting rig sites when required

**To be successful in this role**
,
**you will:**

* Hold a bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited college or university
* Be a fresh engineering graduate or have one to two years of relevant work experience
* Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills
* Be able to prepare clear technical information and confidently support customer and internal discussions
* Have an interest in the drill-bit industry and a willingness to develop knowledge of its products, technologies, markets, competitors, and customers
* Be fluent in spoken and written and English & Hindi
* Be able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and multicultural teams
* Be willing to travel to customer locations and rig sites when required

**Work in a way that works for you**
We recognize that everyone is different and that people perform at their best in different ways. In this role, we can offer the following working arrangements:
  
  
  

* A standard five-day working schedule, with occasional field trips to rig sites
* Hybrid working, subject to business needs and manager approval

**Working with us**
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We are at our best when our people are developed, engaged, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, develop and reward talent, and build leaders at every level so that we can bring out the best in one another.
  
  
**Working for you**
Our innovations have transformed the energy industry for more than a century. To continue progressing, we must keep pushing boundaries. We reward people who embrace change and contribute to our success with a package that reflects how much we value their contribution. When you join us, you can expect:
  
  
  

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and well-being activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Services Professional - Applications Engineering
  
  
**About Us:**
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Join Us:**
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.
