title: Senior Manager - Fundraising & Donor Relations
description:
**Organisation Background**

The Akanksha Foundation is a 30+ year old non-profit organization with the mission to build innovative schools that will empower children & young adults from underserved communities and influence the ecosystem. Akanksha supports 15,000 plus students through the formal-school education program and 5,800alumni from low-income backgrounds. Our 28 English-medium schools run in partnership with municipal corporations in Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Pune and Nagpur. We provide students from underserved communities a high-quality, holistic education at no cost. Our aim is to give students the knowledge, skills, and values they need to lead empowered lives, maximize their potential and break out of the cycle of poverty.

With a vision to scale our impact we codified our practices and, in 2022, joined forces with Nagpur Municipal Corporation and Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation to take these practices to nearly 200 public schools under 'Project Setu'.

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Manager will primarily support the fundraising team by shaping high-quality proposals, donor presentations, impact reports, and compelling written materials that bring together data, research, and human stories. This is a writing-led role for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, and passionate about using words and evidence to open doors for meaningful support.

This role requires strong analytical ability, excellent command of written English, and the ability to translate organisational data, research, and impact into clear, persuasive proposals, reports, presentations, and donor communications

The role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, research-driven, and able to work closely with internal teams to shape compelling funding narratives backed by facts, evidence, and measurable outcomes

**Reports to:**
Senior Director – Donor Relations

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

1) Develop and draft funding proposals including Grants, concept notes, donor presentations, impact reports, and other written materials for international foundations and institutional donors.

2) Translate programme data, research insights, and impact metrics into concise, compelling, and donor-ready narratives.

3) Research donor priorities, funding themes, and sector trends to ensure proposals are aligned with the interests and requirements of target funders.

4) Work with programme, M&E, leadership, and fi nance teams to gather relevant information and convert it into strong fundraising collateral.

5) Support the fundraising team in preparing presentations, background notes, case studies, and other communication materials.

6) Ensure all materials are factually accurate, well-structured, and delivered to high editorial and design standards.

7) Maintain a repository of organisational data, stories, and impact evidence that can be used across donor communications.

**Education:**

1) Graduate or Post Graduate degree in English, Communications, Journalism, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Public Policy or a related field

**Experience:**

1) 10+ years of relevant experience in fundraising support, grant writing, donor communications, development, research or proposal development.

2) Prior experience in the social sector, education or development space will be an advantage.

3) Experience working with HNIs, international foundations, bilateral or multilateral donors, CSR teams or institutional funders is strongly preferred.

4) Exposure to impact reporting, case study writing or donor presentation development is desirable.

**Key Competencies:**

1) Excellent written English, with the ability to write clearly, persuasively and professionally for external audiences.

2) Strong analytical skills and the ability to work with data, evidence and research to build credible proposals.

3) Ability to synthesise large amounts of information into crisp, structured, donor-facing documents.

4) Ability to translate programme work into compelling stories without losing factual rigour.

5) Strong attention to detail, accuracy and consistency in writing and presentation.

6) Strong project coordination, follow-through and organisational skills; highly organised and deadline-driven.

7) Ability to work collaboratively across teams as well as independently; comfortable in a support role that demands precision and high-quality output.

8) Curious, research-oriented and strongly self-motivated.

9) Good command of Google workspace, Microsoft Office, especially Word, PowerPoint and Excel.

**Why Join Akanksha?**

This role puts your writing and research at the heart of Akanksha's growth. Every proposal, impact report and donor presentation you shape helps secure the funding that keeps our 28 schools running and brings a high-quality education to over 15,000 students and 5,800 alumni from low-income communities. Working closely with programme, M&E, leadership and fi nance teams, you will gain a deep, fi rst-hand understanding of what makes great schools work, and turn it into evidence and stories that inspire international foundations, institutional donors and CSR partners to invest in educational equity.

You will be part of a passionate team reimagining public education in India, with real autonomy, strong peer learning, and compensation in the top third of Indian NGO scales, along with medical insurance, provident fund and paid leaves.

: Specialist - Multi Modal Solutions - Global Service Centre

* Support internal and external audit requirements and ensure audit readiness for backoffice transactions.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence, process discipline and continuous improvement within a non-customer-facing environment.

* Experience in intermodal rail operations and/or chassis/container administration will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of order/load management, documentation, billing/invoicing and accessorial processes.

title: Senior Content Writer - Product Marketing
description:

Its programmes help learners build careers across finance, data science, analytics, technology, marketing and management.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Senior Content Writer who combines excellent writing with creative thinking, research depth and a strong understanding of marketing.

You will translate product strengths, customer insights and business objectives into compelling ideas, messaging and content across the customer journey. Your work will cover performance advertising, campaigns, websites, landing pages, brochures, nurture journeys, SEO and other relevant marketing touchpoints.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role working closely with the Product Marketing Manager. You will take ownership from research and ideation to writing, creative briefing, collaboration and timely delivery. We value someone who brings energy and curiosity, confidently recommends ideas, solves problems and moves work forward proactively.

The scope will evolve with business needs, offering opportunities to contribute to brand development, product launches, customer research and broader product marketing initiatives. Flexibility across products, audiences, formats and priorities is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Research and understand**

  : Study products, customers, competitors and market trends to identify audience needs, objections, differentiators and credible proof points.
* **Develop positioning and messaging**

  : Turn product features and insights into clear value propositions, benefit-led narratives and compelling reasons to act.
* **Ideate campaigns**

  : Propose original concepts, hooks, creative angles and storytelling approaches aligned with campaign objectives.
* **Copywriting across the funnel**

  : Develop TOF, MOF and BOF content that builds awareness, supports consideration, nurtures interest and drives conversion.
* **Create performance advertising content**

  : Write static ad copy, video and motion graphics scripts, including headlines, voiceovers, on-screen text, visual cues and CTAs.
* **Own marketing content**

  : Develop website and landing page copy, brochures, presentations, sales collateral, articles and other content required for campaigns and launches.
* **Build nurture journeys**

  : Plan and write WhatsApp and email drip campaigns for lead nurturing, remarketing, events, launches and conversion.
* **Deliver SEO content**

  : Conduct keyword and search-intent research, develop content briefs, and write or refresh articles and website content using sound on-page SEO practices.
* **Brief and collaborate**

  : Create actionable briefs and work with designers, video editors and content creators to bring copy, visuals and storytelling together.
* **Drive timely execution**

  : Coordinate inputs, feedback and revisions; review creative outputs and take responsibility for the quality and timely completion of assigned deliverables.
* **Learn and improve**

  : Use campaign performance, customer feedback and testing insights to refine messaging and recommend new approaches.
* **Contribute beyond individual assets**

  : Support brand voice, messaging frameworks, product launches and wider marketing initiatives, adapting to new channels, formats and business priorities.

**Requirements**

* 5–6+ years of relevant experience in content writing, copywriting or integrated marketing communication; agency experience strongly preferred.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating research, campaign thinking, persuasive writing and ownership from concept to execution.
* Excellent command of English, with the ability to write sharp advertising copy and clear, well-researched long-form content.
* Strong understanding of advertising, branding, product positioning, customer behaviour and full-funnel marketing.
* Experience adapting messaging across B2C, D2C and B2B contexts and different stages of the buying journey.
* Familiarity with performance creative formats across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.
* Hands-on expertise in SEO research and writing, including keywords, search intent, content structure and on-page optimisation.
* Strong research and fact-checking skills, with the ability to understand unfamiliar products and simplify complex information.
* Confidence in presenting ideas, explaining recommendations, asking questions and giving constructive creative feedback.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple briefs, respond to feedback and adapt to changing priorities.
* A proactive working style: identify gaps, suggest solutions, take initiative and follow through with minimal supervision.
* Working knowledge of current AI, research, SEO and content tools, supported by strong editorial judgement and a willingness to learn.
* Interest in developing broader capabilities in brand and product marketing.
* Experience in edtech and with international clients, audiences or markets is a plus.

**Must Share:**

* Updated resume.
* A portfolio showing a range of relevant content and creative work.
* Two campaign examples outlining the objective, audience insight, your idea, your contribution to execution and results where available.

Join our team and build your skills, build innovative solutions and help build a safer world.

description:
NY Equity Documentation Group , Vice President, Institutional Equity Division
  
  
This role is in Mumbai and requires working with the NY Equity Documentation Group based in New York. The role will require a fast-learning, dynamic, pro-active, and self-motivated person to assist the team in its day-to-day activities.
  
  
The current opening is for a professional within the NY team based in Mumbai, with responsibility for documentation aspects of OTC derivative transactions, prime brokerage, cash and stock-lending transactions in the NY region.
  
  
Institutional Securities Documentation (ISD) is a global team based in several locations (including New York, London, Hong Kong, and Tokyo). Within the NY IED we are part of the risk function and we support the equity businesses and handle documentation for prime brokerage and listed derivatives, over-the-counter on equity swaps/options (vanilla and exotic) on global equity underlying, stock-lending, warrants issuance, cash trading, equity research, regulatory remediation and subsets of documentation relating to our coverage areas.
  
  
From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast-changing markets.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity-linked and equity-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.

* Draft, negotiate and execute (including amendments to) master derivatives agreements, including but not limited to ISDA, VM CSA, IM CSA, equity swaps /options and prime brokerage related documentation.

* Responsible for administering and facilitating the agreement execution process; maintain and update clients’ contract database/systems; attend to day-to-day coordination among internal procurement and legal teams with respect to such contracts; and perform due diligence to ensure contract terms and conditions as well as information of the parties is reflected in the client’s contract database/systems.

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Law graduate with relevant 13+ years of experience in financing/derivatives is preferred.
* Experience in team management will be preferred.

* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Prepared to speak to clients (internal and external) at all times.

title: Quality, Health, Safety and Environment (QHSE) Officer/Safety Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose:**

To establish, implement, maintain and continually improve Sara Interiors Pvt. Ltd.’s integrated Quality, Health, Safety and Environment (QHSE) arrangements across interior fit-out, refurbishment, office and bank rollouts, MEP coordination and turnkey projects. The role supports consistent quality delivery, prevention of injuries and occupational ill health, prevention of pollution, compliance with applicable requirements, effective contractor control and reliable project handover.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**> Quality assurance and quality control:**

·  Develop, implement and maintain project quality plans, inspection and test plans (ITPs), checklists, method statements and quality records in coordination with Project Managers and site teams.

·  Review contract requirements, approved drawings, specifications, finish schedules, samples, mock-ups and acceptance criteria before work begins.

·  Coordinate material submittals and approvals; verify deliveries against approved specifications, purchase orders, certificates and condition requirements.

·  Plan and conduct site quality inspections for relevant fit-out activities, including partitions, ceilings, flooring, joinery, painting, glazing, fixtures and MEP interfaces.

·  Ensure hold points and witness points are identified and released before work is concealed or proceeds to the next stage.

·  Raise and track nonconformance reports (NCRs), defects and snags; coordinate root-cause analysis, corrective action, reinspection and closure.

·  Monitor rework, repeat defects, inspection acceptance and material damage; recommend preventive actions and lessons learned.

·  Maintain traceable quality records, test results, approved submittals, as-built information, operation and maintenance documents, warranties and handover evidence.

>
**Health and safety management:**

·  Maintain project HSE plans, hazard identification and risk assessments (HIRA), job safety analyses (JSA), safe work methods and permit-to-work arrangements.

·  Identify and control risks associated with work at height, electrical activities, hot work, power tools, lifting and manual handling, dust, chemicals, concealed services and work in occupied premises.

·  Verify that contractors and subcontractors provide competent personnel, appropriate training, inspected equipment, suitable PPE, task risk assessments and method statements.

·  Coordinate inductions, toolbox talks, safety briefings, worker consultation and communication of changing site conditions.

·  Conduct site inspections and audits; record findings, assign corrective actions and verify closure.

·  Coordinate emergency preparedness, first-aid and fire arrangements, evacuation routes, emergency contacts and drills in line with client/building procedures.

·  Ensure incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and occupational health concerns are reported, investigated and followed by corrective action.

·  Exercise stop-work authority or escalate immediately when serious risk, missing critical controls or unsafe conditions are identified.

**> Environmental management:**

·  Maintain project environmental aspects-and-impacts registers and environmental management plans.

·  Implement controls for waste segregation, reuse and recycling, authorised waste handling, dust, noise, odour, spills, chemical storage and drain protection.

·  Promote efficient use of materials, water and energy and reduction of packaging, damage and avoidable rework.

·  Verify that waste and special/hazardous waste streams are handled through appropriate approved or authorised routes where required; retain collection and transfer records.

·  Respond to environmental incidents and complaints, coordinate containment and clean-up, investigate causes and track corrective actions.

**> Integrated management system and compliance:**

·  Support development, implementation and maintenance of the Integrated Management System (IMS) aligned with ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environment) and ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), where adopted by the company.

·  Maintain controlled policies, procedures, registers, forms, records and revision history; ensure current approved documents are available to relevant users.

·  Identify applicable legal, statutory, regulatory, client, landlord and contractual requirements with competent internal or external support; maintain compliance evidence.

·  Plan and coordinate internal audits, site inspections, management reviews and follow-up actions.

·  Monitor objectives and KPIs, analyse trends, report significant risks and performance to management, and recommend improvement actions.

·  Coordinate certification readiness and external audit logistics when directed; ensure the certification body remains independent and that no certification status is claimed before it is granted.

**> Project and contractor coordination:**

·  Integrate quality and HSE requirements into project mobilisation, procurement, work sequencing, coordination meetings and project close-out.

·  Review contractor work plans and coordinate interfaces between trades, especially ceiling closure, service penetrations, electrical energisation, hot work, deliveries and occupied-area work.

·  Coordinate with clients, project management consultants, designers, building management and subcontractors on inspections, permits, access, shutdowns and acceptance requirements.

·  Ensure lessons learned from defects, incidents, complaints and audits are communicated and reflected in updated controls and training.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

·  Degree or diploma in engineering, construction, quality, occupational safety, environmental management or a related discipline; relevant statutory safety qualification where required for the assigned role.

·  Relevant experience in construction, interior fit-out, commercial projects, facilities or MEP coordination; seniority to reflect company-wide versus site-only responsibility.

·  Working knowledge of quality planning, inspection/testing, NCR and corrective action, contractor management, risk assessment, permit-to-work and environmental controls.

·  Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements and integrated management system documentation.

·  Experience conducting site inspections, audits, incident investigations, toolbox talks, KPI reporting and client/contractor coordination.

·  Ability to read drawings/specifications, maintain records, prepare reports and communicate clearly with office and site personnel.

**Skills & Competencies we look for:**

·  Practical risk-based decision-making and visible site leadership.

·  Strong documentation, inspection, audit and follow-up discipline.

·  Clear communication, worker engagement and contractor coordination.

·  Problem-solving, root-cause analysis and corrective-action verification.

·  Ability to balance quality, safety, environmental controls and programme requirements without bypassing critical controls.

·  Professional integrity, impartial reporting and commitment to continual improvement.

**Documented records and maintained or coordinated:**

·  Project quality plan, ITPs, inspection requests, checklists, test records, material submittals and approvals.

·  NCR, snag, concession/deviation and corrective-action registers.

·  HIRA/JSA, method statements, permit records, induction, training, toolbox talks and equipment inspection records.

·  Environmental aspects register, waste records, SDS, spill/incident reports, complaint log and environmental inspection records.

·  Legal/client compliance register, audit reports, management review actions and KPI dashboards.

·  Project handover index, test/commissioning records, as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties and acceptance records.

* Support the standardization and migration of regulatory reporting activities across APAC jurisdictions while ensuring adherence to regional governance and control requirements.
* Utilize data analytics and visualization tools to develop meaningful management information (MI), dashboards, and reporting metrics to support decision-making and oversight.

**Education\***
Undergraduate / MBA degree with major in banking, finance or data analytics

7 to 10 years of overall experience with at least 12 months of Regulatory Reporting experience

* Experience of regulatory reporting processes – ideally involving report preparation

* Optional (Preferred): Ability to read, write, or speak Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, or Thai would be an added advantage. Strong proficiency in any APAC regional language is highly desirable.
* Proven relationship management / engagement skills and ability to communicate effectively and build relationships with different audiences across the APAC region

**Desired Skills :**

title: Data Collection Transformation - Senior Associate
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
MSCI Sustainability & Climate Data collection team is involved in acquisition of Sustainability & Climate data at scale and QA of the collected data and responsible for establishing and maintaining highest level of data quality and standards across all datasets feeding our ESG products. As an Data Collection Transformation Associate, you will be responsible for delivering on initiatives as part of the S&C transformation agenda. The role focuses on large-scale collection setup & execution and as a Senior Associate, individual is expected to take ownership & drive the collection transformation project working in collaboration with collection team and internal stakeholders.
  
  
Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Insightful Research: Proactively source, analyze, and process global company disclosures, leveraging generative AI to extract meaningful insights across diverse data domains and models.
* Unlock the Power of Information: Work with a vast array of data sources—including annual reports, company websites, quantitative data feeds, web crawlers, and news articles—to transform unstructured information into actionable intelligence.
* Revolutionize Data Collection with AI: Design and implement AI-assisted, scalable models that streamline data sourcing from multiple channels, ensuring comprehensive coverage of issuers.
* Automate & Scale Data Methodologies: Develop innovative, automation-friendly data collection methodologies that convert unstructured data into structured insights through advanced AI-driven “electronification.”
* Engineer Next-Gen AI Models: Build and refine generative AI-powered data extraction models, ensuring continuous improvement in accuracy, efficiency, and performance.
* Lead & Optimize AI Agents: Manage, guide, and enhance AI agents, serving as a validation layer to improve outputs and refine AI-generated insights through expert feedback.
* Shape the Future of Data Operations: Partner with technology and transformation teams to design, optimize, and engineer cutting-edge data workflows and operational processes.
* Enhance Data Quality & Efficiency: Drive automation initiatives that improve data quality diagnostics, reducing manual intervention and increasing operational efficiency
* Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with internal stakeholders and downstream teams to understand data needs, define quality control frameworks, and ensure seamless data delivery.
* Engage with Companies & Clients: Review and process company feedback, address client queries, and contribute to a transparent, data-driven ecosystem that powers critical decision-making.

**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Environmental Science, Data Science, or related interdisciplinary fields.
* 7–12 years of experience in large‑scale data collection, research, data operations, or supply‑chain analysis; climate or sustainability domain experience is an advantage.
* Experience of leading the projects to completion and working with stakeholders and team members
* Experience applying GenAI/LLMs for data extraction, summarization, classification, or workflow automation; ability to build prompt‑based workflows and evaluate model output.
* Familiarity with AI agents, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), or ML‑assisted quality is required.
* Hands‑on experience with Python for automation, web scraping, API integration, data cleaning, and high‑volume processing.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort handling large datasets.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret complex corporate disclosures and extract meaningful supply‑chain insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple time zones and collaborate with cross‑functional partners

title: Tendering Engineer and costing
description:
**Company Description**
Namami InfraInterior is an infrastructure and interior solutions company based in Mumbai, delivering end-to-end services for commercial, residential, and industrial projects. The organization focuses on quality execution, cost-effective solutions, and timely delivery. It collaborates closely with clients, consultants, and vendors to meet project specifications and compliance requirements. Namami InfraInterior offers opportunities to work on diverse projects and encourages professional growth in engineering, procurement, and project management.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Tendering Engineer and Costing role based in Mumbai. The role involves preparing and reviewing quotations, cost estimates, and BOQs for electrical and interior infrastructure projects. The Tendering Engineer will analyze tender documents, technical drawings, and specifications, coordinate with suppliers and vendors for procurement-related information, and negotiate prices and terms where required. Daily tasks include conducting cost comparisons, identifying risks and value-engineering options, and ensuring that tenders comply with technical and commercial requirements. The role involves close communication with internal project teams and external stakeholders to clarify technical queries, support bid submissions, and maintain accurate records of tenders, costs, and procurement data.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to prepare and manage detailed quotations and cost estimates for infrastructure and interior projects.
* Strong analytical skills to interpret tender documents, drawings, and specifications, and perform cost analysis.
* Effective communication skills for coordination with clients, vendors, and internal project teams.
* Experience in procurement activities, including sourcing, vendor management, and price negotiation.
* Background in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline; diploma or degree in Electrical Engineering preferred.
* Proficiency with MS Excel and other costing tools; familiarity with tendering software or ERP systems is an advantage.
* Attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work under deadlines.
* Prior experience in tendering, estimation, or costing within construction, interiors, or infrastructure sectors is beneficial.

title: Assistant Manager
description:

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
CFO is a risk-based program to identify & confirm data gaps in various high risk financial regulatory reports filed by the bank like FR- Y-9C, FR- Y-15, FFIEC 031/041, FFIEC 009, FFIEC 101, COREP, FINREP & AnaCredit & Liquidity Reports. The team also forms an integral part of the remediation work required for MRA raised by FRB for Regulatory Reports filed by the bank.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Executing assessments to review and validate source documents, data source elements and logic adheres to specified business and/or data regulatory requirements
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Review, extraction and documentation of key data elements and logic from SQL or other code, including alignment of such elements with key business requirements.
* Examination of financial information and data attributes for assessment of alignment with instructions, i.e. fit for use and/or BRD (Business Requirements Document) validation activities.
* Assist in issue evaluation and remediation efforts including identification, remediation, monitoring and escalation activities particular to identified conformance or transaction related non-adherence issues and observations.
* Manage relationships across Finance, Data Management, or other line of business support teams.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
CA/CPA, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance
  
  
**Experience Range\***
3 - 5 years experience
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Exposure to US regulatory reports such as FRY-9C, FRY-14Q/M, FFIEC031, FRY-15, FFIEC 009 or EMEA regulatory reports like COREP, FINREP & AnaCredit.
* Experience in analyzing SQL code through either writing the code to match business requirements or validation of code to ensure it executes the business requirements.
* Advanced tool skills in working with large data sets to identify anomalies in the data, in addition to standard knowledge of Microsoft software (Excel, Word, Power Point) including advanced excel functions such as pivot tables, V-lookup, etc.
* Strong communication skills to support partnership across multiple line of business, finance and technology teams.

**Desired Skills**

* Prior experience in Audit, Financial Reporting or Finance Data Management Organizations
* Ideal candidate should have a general comprehension of both GAAP and Regulatory Reporting for large banks.

11:30 am to 8:30 pm

MUM/HYD/CHN

title: AI Agent Engineer Intern
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe AI systems for real-world deployment. Our work spans agentic AI, alignment, interpretability, evaluation systems, enterprise AI, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data.

We build AI systems where transparency, auditability, robustness, and controllability are first-class constraints. Our environment is fast-moving, research-driven, and highly hands-on. We value people who bring open ideas, take ownership, and turn ambiguity into meaningful outcomes.

The Role

We are looking for
****AI Agent Interns****

to work on high-impact agentic AI problems across applied, research, and product directions.

This is not a narrow internship focused on building small internal bots. You will work on real agentic systems, evaluation infrastructure, enterprise use cases, research prototypes, and product tooling that can shape how AI agents are built, tested, aligned, and deployed.

Depending on your interests and strengths, you may contribute across one or more of three tracks:

1. Applied Agentic AI

On the applied side, you will work on high-impact enterprise agentic use cases. This may involve building agents that reason over complex workflows, interact with tools and data systems, execute multi-step processes, evaluate outcomes, and operate reliably in real-world environments.

Example work may include enterprise workflow agents, agents over structured or proprietary data, human-in-the-loop agent systems, decision-support agents, and applied prototypes that can evolve into production-grade components.

Success in this track means building useful, reliable, and high-value agentic systems that solve real enterprise problems.

2. Agent R&D and Evaluation

On the R&D side, you will work on new ideas in agent architecture, harness design, evaluations, long-horizon reasoning, alignment, and interpretability.

This may include building new agent harnesses, designing evaluation frameworks, studying agent failure modes, benchmarking tool use and planning, or contributing to research papers, technical reports, and reusable research infrastructure.

Success in this track means producing research-quality insights, evaluation systems, benchmarks, or technical contributions that improve how agentic systems are understood and assessed.

3. Product and Tooling Agents

On the product and tooling side, you will help build agents that improve how researchers, engineers, and users interact with Lexsi systems.

This may include an
****AlignTune Agent****

for alignment workflows, AI Scientist-style agents for hypothesis generation and experiment execution, tools for evaluating and debugging agents, or product prototypes that turn research capabilities into usable workflows.

Success in this track means building tools that compound the productivity of researchers, engineers, or enterprise users.

Responsibilities

You will explore open-ended agentic AI problems and convert promising ideas into working prototypes, experiments, research artifacts, or product capabilities. You may build applied agents, design evaluations, create harnesses, experiment with planning and memory architectures, analyze failures, document findings, and collaborate with research, engineering, and product teams.

The expected outcome may be a production-grade applied component, a research contribution, a paper, a benchmark, an internal tool, or a product prototype.

Requirements

We are looking for candidates with strong programming skills, preferably in Python, hands-on experience with LLMs or AI systems, and a strong interest in agents, evaluation, alignment, interpretability, or enterprise AI.

You should be comfortable working on ambiguous problems, building prototypes quickly, reading papers or technical material, documenting findings clearly, and independently identifying high-value directions.

Bonus signals include experience with agent frameworks, long-horizon agents, evaluation pipelines, research projects, open-source tools, backend systems, enterprise data, or AI safety and interpretability.

Our Culture

We move quickly and value substance over polish. This internship is for people who want to work near the frontier of agentic AI, bring original ideas, build seriously, test honestly, and create work that matters.

title: Senior Associate - Atlassian Workplace Platforms
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The Atlassian Platform team owns the governance, configuration, and continuous improvement of MSCI’s Atlassian Cloud environment — Jira Software, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery, and Rovo — which serves as the operational backbone for approximately two-thirds of MSCI’s global workforce. We keep the platform reliable, well-governed, and strategically aligned with how MSCI works. Beyond keeping the lights on, we are the internal centre of expertise for what the Atlassian platform can do — including its rapidly expanding AI capabilities — and how to use those capabilities in ways that are practical, cost-justified, and genuinely useful to the teams that depend on us.
  
  
We are establishing a presence in Mumbai to extend our operational coverage into the APAC timezone and build a trusted platform relationship with MSCI’s India-based stakeholder community. This role is that presence. You will enter through deep operational immersion — learning how a regulated financial technology firm uses Atlassian at enterprise scale — and grow into a broader mandate as you demonstrate the judgment and organizational fluency to advise internal teams on how to solve their real problems using the platform, including where AI fits and where it does not.
  
  
Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the primary APAC point of contact for the Atlassian Platform Support queue: triaging and resolving platform requests covering Jira project setup, Confluence space configuration, API token provisioning and renewal, board configuration, permission management, and user access — handling these with both technical accuracy and clear stakeholder communication.
* Manage Atlassian REST API tokens and service account credentials for teams integrating Jira and Confluence into automation pipelines, reporting tools, and AI agents — including provisioning, expiry monitoring, rotation, and advising requestors on appropriate access scoping.
* Execute platform administration and KTLO activities: Jira and Confluence configuration maintenance, sandbox environment lifecycle management, licensing inventory support, and governance documentation — building operational depth that becomes the foundation for everything else.
* Advise internal stakeholder teams on how to solve workflow and collaboration problems within the Atlassian platform, distinguishing between requests that need configuration work, requests that could benefit from AI-assisted automation, and requests where the right answer is a simpler process rather than a new tool.
* Evaluate AI use cases within the Atlassian ecosystem — Rovo agents, AI-assisted automation rules, Confluence AI features — with a practical lens: does this use case justify its token cost, does it solve a real process problem, and is it sustainable at scale? MSCI’s Procurement function monitors AI spend, and your advisory work directly informs those cost decisions.
* Build and maintain documentation in Confluence for platform standards, support procedures, and recurring processes — progressively converting tribal knowledge into institutional knowledge accessible to the teams that need it.
* Develop working relationships with MSCI’s internal stakeholder functions — InfoSec, IT Risk, Privacy, Compliance, PMO, Product, and Finance — learning their constraints, building credibility, and becoming the person those teams trust to engage when they have a platform or AI tooling question.
* Participate in Atlassian Platform Roadmap sprint ceremonies with the Monterrey (Mexico) team, contributing operational insight from the APAC support queue to inform platform roadmap prioritization and governance decisions.

Your Growth Path
  
  
This role is support-first by design, not by limitation. The Atlassian platform at MSCI is complex, highly governed, and deeply embedded in how the firm operates. Understanding it well enough to give good advice takes time and direct exposure — and that exposure comes through the support queue.
  
  
The progression to broader platform ownership — including contribution to integration decisions, enterprise reporting, and firm-wide AI tooling advisory — is earned through a specific kind of readiness: the ability to independently navigate MSCI’s internal stakeholder landscape. You will be ready when you can engage InfoSec on API governance, work through IT Risk on platform change approvals, align with Privacy on Confluence data handling, and advise PMO, Product, and Finance on platform configuration choices without requiring escalation. The team will invest actively in getting you there.
  
  
**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**

* 3–5 years of experience working with Jira Cloud and/or Confluence Cloud in an enterprise environment, with hands-on familiarity with project and space administration, workflow configuration, and permission management.
* Working knowledge of Atlassian REST APIs: you understand token-based authentication, can help a team diagnose an access failure, and know the difference between what should be an API integration and what should just be a native automation rule.
* Genuine, applied AI fluency — not familiarity in theory but changed behavior in practice. You use AI tools to do your actual work faster and better. Critically, you also know when not to use AI: when a simpler approach is more reliable, more maintainable, or more cost-effective. That judgment is as valuable as the capability.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English, with the professional confidence to engage senior internal stakeholders clearly, manage expectations accurately, and translate technical platform constraints into language that non-technical audiences can act on.
* A service mindset with operational discipline: you treat support as a craft, not a waiting room. You document what you learn, identify patterns in recurring requests, and look for the upstream fix rather than just closing the ticket.
* Comfort in an asynchronous, distributed team model with a significant timezone gap. You own your queue independently, keep the Monterrey (Mexico) team unblocked, and communicate proactively rather than waiting to be asked.
* This is an individual contributor role. Atlassian certifications are a plus but not a prerequisite. Deep scripting experience is not required at entry. What matters most is platform judgment, communication credibility, and the kind of AI literacy that makes you a trusted advisor rather than an enthusiast.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

title: Design Systems Analyst
description:
Broadway Malyan is a global architecture, urbanism and design practice dedicated to creating cities, buildings and places that will provide a lasting legacy. Through a shared design ethos, we work together to create places with a strong sense of identity where people and communities want to live, learn, shop, work and relax.

As an employee-owned practice, we are able to create an inclusive culture where everyone has a strong sense of engagement and shared responsibility in the future of our business. We are committed to investing and inspiring our people, so we can attract and retain the best talent to strengthen our reputation as both a design practice and an employer of choice.

Broadway Malyan is currently seeking to recruit a
**Design System Analyst**
., based out of our Mumbai Studio. As an Design Systems Analyst, you'll sit at the point where our project teams and our core digital design software meet — helping diagnose why a workflow or model is underperforming, supporting studios in using our design technology effectively, and building toward advanced computational design, BIM and design automation skills as you grow. You'll work closely with IT (who handle hardware/infrastructure issues) while owning the functional side: how our tools are actually being used on live projects, and why they sometimes aren't working as effectively as intended.

**Key activities:**

* Diagnose and triaging issue requiring technical support or if is functional related relative to our core design software, (eg: slow performing revit or rhino models).
* Debugging low complexity low code/no code scripts within grasshopper and/or dynamo, whilst escalating where best practices, or training gaps could address issues.
* Support project teams across our studios with knowledge based articles, preliminary model health checks, and best-practice model authoring.
* Build and maintain general standard operating procedures, and training materials for our Standard Design Professional Tools as needed.
* Get hands-on exposure to BIM, computational design, design automation and AI-for-design tools, with a defined path toward those specialisms as you develop.
* Work closely with our IT team on hands on technical vs. functional issues.

**What you'll bring to the team:**

* 1+ years' experience using design software in a professional architecture, engineering, design or BIM design production environment (placements/internships can be included).
* Working knowledge of at least two of these softwares: AutoCAD, Revit, Dynamo, Rhino (Grasshopper), and SketchUp.
* An analytical, curious mindset — genuine interest in
  *why*
  a BIM model or design workflow fails to work effectively.
* Clear written and verbal communication — as you will be documenting technical issues to non-technical project staff regularly.
* Desirable: a degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Technologist, BIM Management, or a related discipline (not a prerequisite — relevant hands-on experience will be considered equally).
* Desirable: exposure to Esri ArcGIS, D5 Render or Enscape, or basic scripting (Python, C#).

**Working conditions:**

* Based on-site at our Mumbai studio.
* This role operates a Monday–Friday rotational shift pattern to align with studio working hours across our global time zones (covering early-morning through to late-evening shifts). Exact shift schedule and rotation cadence to be confirmed with IT/HR.
* Weekends off (Saturday and Sunday), plus standard Indian public/bank holidays.
* Shift allowances apply for early or late shift bands, per standard company policy.

If you are a dynamic professional, willing to develop and excel in a technical environment and ready to take new challenges, we are looking forward to receiving your application.

Broadway Malyan is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Horizon Global is a designer, manufacturer, and distributor of high-quality, custom-engineered towing, trailering, cargo management, and related accessory products serving automotive aftermarket, retail, and OE channels globally. Following its acquisition by Flex-N-Gate, the company now operates as part of the FNG family, with a continued focus on innovation, operational excellence, and customer service.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Product Engineer is responsible for assisting with the design, analysis, and quoting activity and testing of new products and support in production products with engineering changes or other aspects as required. Working with the Product Designer and sales/manufacturing teams, the Product Engineer identifies and facilitates product features and improvements. He/she reviews product drawings, specifications and prototypes, preparing reports as necessary at each stage of development and reviews product test results. He/she liaises with customers to review and update product status/timing and engineering changes. He/she ensures product meets and exceeds all customer specifications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Engineering and Innovation for Injection-Molded, Over molded, Welded, and Sheet Metal products, from concept development through production launch and product sustainment.
* Outcome-driven engineer with a strong focus on Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), Material Selection, FMEA, APQP, DVP&R and VAVE.
* Review engineering drawings, specifications, schematics and existing products to ensure compliance with customer requirements while identifying opportunities to improve product quality, functionality, manufacturability, reliability, and cost.
* Develop accurate 3D models, 2D manufacturing drawings, design layouts, and BOMs using SolidWorks.
* Design and detail mechanical components and assemblies ensuring Form, Fit, Function, Manufacturability, and cost effectiveness.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to support new product development, Engineering quotations and design improvement projects.
* Knowledge of industry standards and compliance requirements, including SAE, ASTM, ASME , IATF 16949 (formerly TS 16949)and ISO standards.
* Revise drawings, BOMs, and engineering documentation based on design changes and ECRs.
* Perform reverse engineering and competitive benchmarking to identify product strengths, weaknesses, localization opportunities, and value engineering (VAVE) improvements. Also analyze competitor products and identify opportunities for product improvement.
* Validate design features, dimensions, tolerances, and GD&T requirements. Knowledge of tolerance stack-up analysis will be an added advantage.
* Support new product development activities from concept through production by reviewing designs, prototypes, validation results, engineering changes, and ensuring project milestones are achieved.
* Investigate product issues, perform root cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and support continuous product improvement initiatives.
* Develop, review, validate and document engineering deliverables in line with quality, cost, safety and performance expectations.

* Experience in modelling and detailing mechanical components and assemblies.

* Strong proficiency in SolidWorks (Part, Assembly, Drawing and BOM).
* Ability to interpret sketches, concepts, and engineering specifications.
* Knowledge of mechanical drafting standards and GD&T.
* Hands-on experience with Vernier Calipers, Micrometers and other measuring instruments.
* Understanding of 3D Printing, Machining, Sheet metal, Fabrication, Injection Molding or other manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of mechanical assemblies and component interaction.
* Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

title: Lead, EV Product Stabilization
description:
Bus & Truck | Operating Depots

Reports to: Head of Contract Manufacturing

Location: Mumbai, Pune with Need based Travel

Type: Full-time

Role Summary

Own the stabilization of newly launched EV buses and trucks at operating depots. You resolve early-life vehicle problems quickly, drive permanent fixes with the manufacturer and design teams, and ensure smooth induction of each new product into daily operation, so fleets reach target uptime and the customer's confidence is built from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Depot induction and stabilization

Plan and lead induction of new vehicles at depots: commissioning checks, charging readiness, driver and maintenance team briefing, and trial runs.

Run a structured stabilization program for each new product or batch (typically the first 3-6 months): daily issue tracking, uptime monitoring and escalation.

Deploy and manage field engineers at depots; ensure round-the-clock response during the initial run-in period.

Co-ordinate with maintenance and OEM tech support team for resolution of recurring issues.

Field Issue resolution along with OEMs for various ongoing projects

Problem resolution

Diagnose and resolve early-life issues across the e-powertrain, battery/BMS, charging, HV systems, thermal management, brakes, HVAC, body and electronics.

Use telematics, fault-code and fleet data to detect patterns, find root causes (8D, 5-Why, FTA) and separate product, process, charging-infrastructure and operator-driven causes.

Drive permanent corrective actions with the CM/OEM, design and suppliers, and verify fixes on the vehicle, including software updates and retrofits.

Manage retrofit and campaign rollout across depots, with tracking to closure.

Operations and customer interface

Be the technical point of contact for depot managers, fleet operators and STUs on new product issues.

Coordinate spare parts, service support and warranty resolution so vehicles are not off-road for long.

Train drivers and depot maintenance staff on operation, charging practices, HV safety and basic troubleshooting.

Support charging infrastructure readiness and performance (CCS2/GB-T, charger-vehicle compatibility, power availability).

Feedback and governance

Feed field learnings into design, manufacturing and PDI checkpoints to prevent recurrence in new builds.

Track stabilization KPIs and issue closure; report to leadership and customers through regular reviews.

Support warranty analysis and cost recovery from the CM/suppliers.

Lead and develop a team of field engineers and depot coordinators.

Authority

Prioritize and escalate field issues across CM, design and supplier teams

Recommend vehicle withdrawal, stop-use or campaign actions on safety-critical issues

Sign off on vehicle stabilization exit and handover to regular service

Qualifications

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Automobile or Electrical/Electronics Engineering.

10-14 years in the automotive CV industry, with at least 6-8 years in field issue resolution, product stabilization, service or fleet operations. Direct experience with electric buses or trucks preferred.

Skills

Strong knowledge of bus and truck systems and EV architecture: battery, BMS, motor, inverter, charging, HV safety

Field diagnostics using EV diagnostic tools and telematics/fleet data

8D, 5-Why, FTA, FMEA, Pareto

Warranty, spare parts and service processes

Understanding of CMVR, AIS standards (AIS-038, 039, 156, 004) and depot operations

Stakeholder management with operators, STUs, OEMs and suppliers; calm and decisive under pressure

Valid HV safety training or certification is a plus

KPIs

Fleet uptime/availability during stabilization

Time to resolve (MTTR) and open-issue ageing

Repeat and early-life failure rate (per 1,000 km or per vehicle)

Retrofit/campaign closure rate

Depot and customer satisfaction

Warranty cost and recovery

Time to stabilization exit for each product

Working Conditions

Travel across depots (indicative 50-60%); may be stationed at a depot during launch; flexibility for extended hours during induction and breakdown escalations.

Interested candidates please share your cv at
**fatima.s@transvolt.in**

**About the Role:**

The Technical & Estimation Manager – Acoustics Division shall be responsible for handling techno-commercial estimation activities for large-scale projects across multiple sectors such as Commercial Offices, Airports, Hospitality, Healthcare, Educational Institutes, Industrial Projects, Auditoriums, Studios, Public Infrastructure, and Institutional Buildings.

This role involves studying tender documents, BOQs, technical specifications, drawings, and supply scope requirements to prepare accurate cost estimates, project budgets, and proposal submissions for acoustic product manufacturing and supply projects. The Estimation Manager acts as a key bridge between Sales, Design, Projects, Production, Procurement, and Clients to ensure technically compliant and commercially competitive quotations.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Tender & BOQ Evaluation:**

* Study tender documents, BOQs, architectural drawings, acoustic consultant specifications, and project supply scope in detail.
* Analyze project requirements for acoustic products including wall panels, ceiling systems, baffles, partitions, PET panels, and customized acoustic solutions.
* Identify project risks, exclusions, deviations, and technical clarifications before quotation submission.
* Review techno commercial terms, delivery schedules, and project execution requirements.

**Quantity Take-Off & Cost Estimation:**

* Prepare detailed quantity take-offs from drawings and BOQs.
* Develop accurate project costing considering raw materials, manufacturing cost, accessories, hardware, labor, logistics, wastage, installation requirements, and margins.
* Coordinate with Production, Purchase, and Design departments for latest material pricing and manufacturing feasibility.
* Prepare item-wise costing sheets, rate analysis, and final commercial offers.

**Technical Proposal & Bid Submission:**

* Prepare techno-commercial proposals and estimation documents for projects.
* Ensure quotations comply with consultant specifications and customer requirements.
* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for bid submission timelines.
* Prepare comparison sheets against competitor specifications and support value engineering activities.

**Project Coordination & Scope Management:**

* Coordinate with Architects, Acoustic Consultants, PMC teams, Contractors, and Clients for technical discussions and clarifications.
* Understand project execution methodology and align estimation with practical installation and production requirements.
* Ensure proper scope mapping between supply items, exclusions, and client expectations.
* Support project handover meetings with Projects and Operations teams after order finalization.

**Value Engineering & Cost Optimization:**

* Suggest alternative materials, systems, and acoustic solutions to optimize project cost while maintaining performance standards.
* Identify opportunities for standardization and manufacturing optimization.
* Support management in improving pricing strategy, raw material and resources optimization and estimation accuracy.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Work closely with Sales, Design, R&D, Production, Planning, Purchase, and Accounts teams.
* Coordinate with factory teams for production lead times and feasibility.
* Support Management with budgeting and forecasting for upcoming projects.

**Documentation & Reporting:**

* Maintain organized records of tender documents, BOQs, quotations, approvals, and estimation history.
* Prepare MIS reports related to project estimations, order conversion ratios, pending tenders, and costing analysis.
* Maintain estimation databases and standard costing templates for future projects.

**Market & Technical Knowledge:**

* Stay updated with market trends, acoustic materials, competitor products, and industry standards.
* Understand acoustic performance parameters such as NRC, STC, CAC, reverberation control, and fire compliance standards.
* Keep track of material cost fluctuations and vendor developments.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Civil, Mechanical, Interior, Architecture, or related technical field.**
* **Proven experience (6–15 years) in Estimation, Tendering, or Quantity Surveying for Interior, Acoustic, Construction, Building Material, or Manufacturing industries.**
* Strong understanding of BOQ analysis, technical specifications, and project costing.
* Experience handling large-scale commercial and institutional projects.
* Ability to study architectural and technical drawings independently.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in Architectural product solution or Acoustic Products or Interior Products or Ceiling Systems, Modular Products, Furniture, Building Materials, or Construction-related industries.
* **Proficiency with AutoCAD is must**
  , Excel-based estimation systems, Estimation software, ERP software, and costing tools.
* Experience working with Manufacturer, Architects, PMCs, and Acoustic Consultants.
* Knowledge of project contracts and tendering processes will be an added advantage.

**SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:**

**Technical & Commercial Understanding:**

* Strong capability in BOQ interpretation and technical specification analysis.
* Understanding of Drawings, costing structures and commercial evaluation.

**Analytical & Problem Solving:**

* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail.
* Ability to identify project risks and estimation gaps.

**Communication & Coordination:**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to handle consultant and customer discussions professionally.

**Time Management:**

* Ability to manage multiple tenders and tight submission deadlines effectively.

**Software Skills:**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, AutoCAD, ERP systems, and estimation tools.

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
**Description**
*Position at Ziff Davis*
Product Support Specialist
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
The Opportunity:
  
  
We are seeking a Product Support Specialist to act as the bridge between Dwell subscribers and our engineering team. In this role, you will report to the director of revenue products. In this hybrid role, you will spend part of your time leading high-touch customer support and relationship management, and the other part translating those frontline insights into the product roadmap. You understand user pain points firsthand because you talk to customers every day, and you have the technical and strategic skills to build permanent solutions into our software or service offerings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Customer Service & Advocacy
  
  

* Customer Support Response Management: Handle approximately 200 customer support tickets per week for Dwell brand subscribers, including email tickets and phone support for customer voicemails
* Payment and Account Administration: Utilize Stripe platform to resolve customer access issues, update user email addresses and payment methods, and address general customer concerns
* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.
* Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with subscribers, gathering qualitative feedback on product experience.

Product Management
  
  

* Feedback Synthesis: Analyze support ticket trends, churn reasons, and customer feature requests to identify systemic product gaps.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing urgent customer fixes with long-term strategic product goals.
* Requirements Definition: Write Product Requirements Documents and user stories for the engineering and design teams.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with engineering, QA, and marketing to guide features from concept through launch, ensuring the support team is fully trained before release.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including Customer Satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Retention/Churn, and Feature Adoption Rates.
* Report monthly insights to executive leadership regarding how product updates impact customer happiness and business revenue.

Job Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience: 3+ years of combined experience in customer service management, customer success, or technical support, alongside 2+ years in an associate product manager or product-adjacent role.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Customer Empathy: Exceptional listening, patience, and written/verbal communication skills with a proven track record of de-escalating frustrated clients.
* Product Sense: Ability to look at a repetitive customer complaint and conceptualize a scalable, software-driven solution.
* Experience using modern helpdesk software (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud) and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Asana).
* Preferred: basic technical literacy (familiarity with API logs, SQL, or web technologies) to effectively communicate tradeoffs with engineering teams.

For over two decades, Dwell has been the definitive voice of modern architecture and design, exploring how smart, intentional design makes everyday life better across print, Dwell.com, and social channels.

Today, Ziff Davis is focused on seven key verticals – Technology, Connectivity, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and Marketing Technology. title: Computer Engineering
description:
**Computer Engineering — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI systems. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep technical knowledge will directly shape how AI reasons about hardware, architecture, and systems.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to apply your expertise in a meaningful, flexible way — working remotely on cutting-edge AI problems at the frontier of computer engineering.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Complex Challenges — Craft advanced computer engineering problems spanning RISC-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, and hardware-software co-design to stress-test AI reasoning
* Author Gold-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions — including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams — that serve as reference benchmarks for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated code (C/C++, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and OS kernels for technical accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards
* Refine AI Reasoning — Identify logical flaws such as race conditions, memory leaks, and timing constraint violations, and deliver structured feedback that improves how AI models think through problems

**Who You Are**

* Pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science (hardware focus), or a closely related discipline
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of: Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems
* Able to communicate complex hardware concepts and low-level software logic clearly in writing
* Precise and detail-oriented — comfortable working at the level of bit operations, clock cycles, and timing diagrams
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or AI benchmarking
* Proficiency in engineering tools such as MATLAB, SolidWorks, or ANSYS
* Familiarity with embedded systems toolchains or HDL simulation environments

**Why Join Us**

* Work on intellectually stimulating problems at the frontier of AI development
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Collaborate with a global network of domain experts and leading AI researchers
* Freelance autonomy with the potential for ongoing contract extension
* Make a direct, lasting impact on how AI understands the physical and logical world of computing

title: Research Mentor
description:
1.About Uppseekers

Uppseekers is a premium study abroad counseling company dedicated to helping studentsachieve their international education goals. We provide end-to-end guidance, from profilebuilding and university shortlisting to applications, scholarships, financial aid, and visa support.Our team of certified and experienced counselors delivers personalized, data-driven guidance to help students secure admission to leading universities worldwide and maximize their academic and scholarship opportunities.

2. Role Overview

Freelance Research Mentor

We are looking for passionate and experienced Research Mentor to join our growing team at Uppseekers.📍 Location: Remote💼

Type: Freelance💰

Compensation: To be finalized post discussion

The Research Mentor will be responsible for guiding students through the research paper development lifecycle, from understanding research fundamentals and refining a research question to reviewing completed papers and assisting with journal selection and submission.

The ideal candidate should be capable of simplifying research concepts for school students, providing structured academic guidance, and maintaining high standards of research quality, originality, and academic integrity.

3. Key Responsibilities

A. Research Teaching and Student Mentorship

Conduct structured online mentoring sessions for high school students in Grades 7–12.

Teach research fundamentals, including research question formulation, literature reviews, research methodology, data collection, analysis, interpretation, and academic writing.

Help students refine their research topics, objectives, hypotheses, and scope based on their interests and academic capabilities.

Guide students in identifying credible sources, understanding citations and referencing styles, and avoiding plagiarism.

Explain research concepts in a student-friendly manner and ensure students understand the work they produce.

Track student progress and provide actionable guidance throughout the research process.

B. Research Paper Review and Quality Improvement

Review completed research papers for structure, clarity, originality, methodology, data interpretation, referencing, and academic quality.

Provide detailed, constructive feedback and identify areas requiring revision.

Guide students through multiple rounds of revisions until the paper meets an appropriate submission standard.

Identify methodological weaknesses, unsupported conclusions, citation issues, and gaps in the literature review.

Ensure students retain authorship and ownership of their work, with all revisions reflecting genuine student understanding and contribution.

Maintain clear review records and communicate progress to the assigned program manager or counselling team.

C. Journal Shortlisting and Publication Assistance

Identify credible journals, student research journals, and other appropriate academic publication venues relevant to each paper's subject and quality.

Evaluate journals based on subject relevance, editorial standards, peer-review process, indexing where applicable, publication timelines, fees, eligibility criteria, and credibility.

Prepare a recommended journal shortlist with the rationale for each recommendation.

Explain submission requirements, formatting guidelines, author declarations, and documentation to students.

Assist students in preparing manuscripts for submission and navigating the submission process.

Guide students through editorial feedback, rejection, resubmission, and revisions when required.

Maintain realistic expectations regarding publication timelines and outcomes; never guarantee acceptance or publication.

D. Documentation and Coordination

Maintain student-wise records of mentoring sessions, research milestones, review comments, and pending tasks.

Submit progress updates and flag delays or academic concerns to the Program Manager.

Coordinate with counsellors and the research team to align research deliverables with each student's broader academic profile-building plan.

Ensure timely completion of assigned mentoring sessions, paper reviews, and publication-support deliverables.

Follow Uppseekers' internal processes for scheduling, reporting, and student communication.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed on the quality, timeliness, and effectiveness of mentoring rather than publication outcomes alone.

KPI

* 100% of assigned sessions conducted as scheduled, subject to approved rescheduling

* 100% of session notes and progress updates submitted within the prescribed timeline

* Initial review completed within 3–5 working days of receiving a complete manuscript, unless otherwise agreed

* Reviews provide specific, actionable feedback covering relevant academic and methodological issues

* Students receive structured guidance through the agreed revision cycles

* A relevant, evidence-based shortlist provided within 3–5 working days after the paper is ready for journal evaluation

* Submission requirements and next steps communicated clearly and promptly

* Progress against agreed research milestones is tracked and delays are escalated proactively

* Positive student feedback on clarity, responsiveness, and usefulness of mentorship

* No tolerance for plagiarism, fabricated data, manipulated results, or misleading publication claims

* Targets may be adjusted based on paper complexity, student readiness, mentor workload, and the agreed scope of engagement.

5. Requirements and Qualifications

* A PhD, with research experience in a any discpline.

* Prior experience in academic research, research writing, manuscript review, or research mentorship.

* Strong understanding of research methodology, academic writing, literature reviews, citations, and referencing.

* Ability to critically evaluate research papers and provide structured, constructive feedback.

* Familiarity with academic journals, submission processes, editorial review, and publication ethics.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to explain complex academic concepts in a simple and engaging way to high school students.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple students and deadlines remotely.

Preferred Qualifications

* A PhD, with research experience in a any discpline.

* Experience mentoring school students or undergraduate students on research projects.

* Experience publishing papers in credible, peer-reviewed journals.

* Familiarity with journal indexing, peer-review standards, publication fees, and predatory-journal identification.

* Experience assisting with manuscript revisions, journal rejections, resubmissions, and editorial correspondence.

* Familiarity with tools such as Google Scholar, Zotero, Mendeley, Google Docs, and plagiarism-screening tools.

6. Skills and Competencies

* Research expertise: Ability to assess the quality and feasibility of student research.

* Mentorship: Patient, structured, and encouraging approach to teaching young learners.

* Critical evaluation: Ability to identify weaknesses in methodology, argumentation, and evidence.

* Academic writing: Strong command of research structure, clarity, and referencing.

* Publication knowledge: Ability to distinguish credible publication venues from questionable ones.

* Communication: Clear written feedback and professional student interaction.

* Ownership: Consistent follow-through on assigned deliverables and deadlines.

* Ethical judgment: Commitment to originality, transparent authorship, and responsible research practices.

7. Expected Deliverables

For each assigned student, the Research Mentor may be responsible for:

* Conducting scheduled research mentoring sessions.

* Helping the student define and execute a feasible research project.

* Reviewing the completed manuscript and sharing consolidated feedback.

* Guiding the student through revisions and quality checks.

* Preparing a journal shortlist with supporting information and recommendations.

* Assisting with manuscript formatting and the submission process.

* Tracking submission status and advising on editorial feedback or resubmission, as included in the agreed scope.

* Submitting session records and progress reports to Uppseekers.

* The number of sessions, review rounds, and publication-support requirements will be defined for each student assignment.

8. Working Arrangement

* Remote, online mentoring.

* Flexible scheduling based on student availability and mentor commitments.

* Engagement may be part-time, freelance, or contractual.

* Compensation will be based on the agreed engagement model, session requirements, and scope of work.

* Timely communication and adherence to assigned student milestones are essential.

9. Success in This Role

* A successful Research Mentor will help students become more capable, independent researchers; improve the quality and credibility of their manuscripts; and make informed decisions about suitable publication opportunities. The goal is to deliver a rigorous, ethical, and well-supported research experience that strengthens each student's academic development.

To Apply: Share your updated CV over at raj.bane@uppseekers.com with the subject line "Research Mentor Application".

title: Senior Content Writer-B2B
description:

The role
